scripts.install:all: powershell -Command "pip install -r backend/requirements.txt; cd admin-dashboard; npm install --legacy-peer-deps; cd ../staff-portal; npm install; cd ../super-admin-dashboard; npm install"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix admin-dashboard --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix admin-dashboard && npm install --prefix staff-portal --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix staff-portal && npm install --prefix super-admin-dashboard --legacy-peer-deps --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix super-admin-dashboard
scripts.sync:apps: npm run sync:cadet && npm run sync:admin
scripts.build:apk:apps: npm run build:apk:cadet && npm run build:apk:admin
